svg.aria-label: Flyer styled as a Halloween party invitation: You're invited to We Never Stop Fearing, a Power BI data story for the Halloween DataViz Contest 2026. 91% still name a fear as adults; fear of the dark falls from 46% to 13% while fear of the future rises from 10% to 40%. 105 people, 30+ countries.

g.text: A Power BI data story for the Halloween DataViz
